decisions.decision: Remove the list of former COA members, the Eagle House tri-fold and the contact list from the new board member orientation packet and hand them out separately; the rest of the board agreed. Ms. Brown continues work on COA and Eagle House history.
decisions.quote: suggested handing those documents out separately from the packet. the rest of the board agreed.

decisions.decision: Board members to think about how to make COA actions more visible and discuss the ideas at the next meeting.
decisions.quote: ms. lincoln urged board members to think about how they could make the actions of the coa more visible, and seem more important in the eyes of the town, so they can discuss those ideas at the next meeting.

decisions.decision: Director asked the Town Clerk to verify names and dates of birth on the town list and report the name of the oldest resident of Lunenburg.
decisions.quote: ms. doherty asked the town clerk to verify the names and dates of birth on the town list and get back to her with the name of the oldest resident of lunenburg.

decisions.decision: The Town Accountant, Town Manager and Director agreed municipal funds will cover the Assistant Meal Site Manager's salary until FY23 Formula Grant funds are decided (reported to the board; not a board vote).
decisions.quote: all agreed to cover the salary of the assistant meal site manager under municipal funds until the fy23 formula grant funds are decided.

budget_items.topic: Salary Admin Plan revised pay schedule
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The new Salary Admin Plan wages were $3 per hour higher than the Director had budgeted from Formula Grant funds.
budget_items.quote: the wages in that plan were too high, $3 more per hour, for what ms. doherty budgeted for formula grant funds.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The senior center is slated to receive $12 per elder in FY23 Formula Grant funds, with the population basis uncertain.
budget_items.quote: as of now the senior center is slated to receive $12 per elder; however, it is unknown whether population numbers will be based on the latest 2020 census data.

budget_items.topic: Municipal funding of Assistant Meal Site Manager salary
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Municipal funds will cover the Assistant Meal Site Manager's salary until FY23 Formula Grant funds are decided. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: all agreed to cover the salary of the assistant meal site manager under municipal funds until the fy23 formula grant funds are decided.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A senior property tax work-off person was hired to weed the grounds. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty reported a senior property tax work-off person has been hired to take care of the weeding on the grounds.

budget_items.topic: Tax relief for seniors in FY22
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Remarks that tax relief for seniors was not a high enough town priority in FY22. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: that tax relief for seniors was not a high enough priority for the town in fy22.
